notes: DCA initial prospective need was 348 units; borough contested and adopted 205 units with RDP of only 3 (vacant land adjustment), leaving 202 units as unmet need. Planning Board adopted HEFSP June 17, 2025; Borough Council endorsed June 24, 2025; filed June 30, 2025. FSHC challenged plan (one of 16 towns challenged statewide, 6 in Bergen County). Borough also joined Local Leaders for Responsible Planning coalition lawsuit challenging the state AH law — dismissed with prejudice. A separate Fourth Round overlay/KPMG site dispute resulted in a judge (Feb 10, 2026 ruling) requiring borough to retain former KPMG site (34 acres, SHG Montvale MB VI LLC) as inclusionary housing site with up to 250 units / 50 affordable, or find equivalent alternative within 3 yrs. Note: the 615-unit / 106-affordable Round 3 settlement (Mercedes, Sony, A&P sites) was approved Jan 2025 and carries a 44-unit surplus that partially offsets Round 4 obligation.
